def _encode_amount(cents):
    """Serialize an integer amount of minor units to the house-private
    wire form `<sign><digits>#<check>`.

    <sign>   '+' for non-negative, '-' for negative
    <digits> absolute amount in minor units (integer cents), no decimal point
    <check>  (sum of the decimal digits in <digits>) mod 10
    """
    sign = '-' if cents < 0 else '+'
    digits = str(abs(int(cents)))
    check = sum(int(d) for d in digits) % 10
    return "{0}{1}#{2}".format(sign, digits, check)

    """Post `cents` (integer minor units) to account `acct` with memo `reason`.

    The amount is wire-encoded before posting; returns the new entry id.
    """
    return post(acct, _encode_amount(cents), reason)
